records.name: NIHB Mental Health Counselling Benefit
records.description: Coverage for eligible professional mental-health counselling when it is not available through another public or private plan.
records.population_served: Eligible registered First Nations and recognized Inuit clients in Canada
records.service_area: Canada-wide, subject to regional administration and eligibility rules
records.eligibility: NIHB client eligibility and benefit rules apply; review the current official guide.
records.access_pathway: Choose an eligible provider and confirm current coverage and billing arrangements through the official NIHB information.

source.title: Non-Insured Health Benefits program for First Nations and Inuit: Mental health counselling benefits

records.name: Hope for Wellness Helpline
records.organization: Indigenous Services Canada / Hope for Wellness
records.description: Immediate, culturally aware emotional support, crisis intervention and help finding other wellness supports.
records.population_served: First Nations, Inuit and Métis people across Canada
records.eligibility: Available to Indigenous people across Canada.
records.access_pathway: Call 1-855-242-3310 or use the online chat; urgent danger still requires local emergency services.

records.name: FNHA-funded Treatment Centres and Recovery Services
records.description: Official navigation to First Nations-focused residential, outpatient, withdrawal-management and recovery services in British Columbia.
records.population_served: Eligibility varies by centre; the official directory identifies First Nations, Inuit, Indigenous youth and other program-specific populations.
records.eligibility: Review the current centre description and referral package; eligibility and intake differ by program.
records.access_pathway: Use the official directory and current referral package, then contact the selected program or FNHA.
